buildPolicy: Copy only trusted already-qualified source-free image bytes; no RUN/package installation or task source in build context, no host mounts/credentials, no image pull or build network. Minimal explicit ENV and no VOLUME/ONBUILD. Candidate qualifies tool availability only.

rust-02.toolProbe: rustc -vV; cargo --version; dpkg-query -W libpcap-dev libpcap0.8-dev libasound2-dev

executionPolicy: Only trusted cargo fetch --locked, go mod download (GOTOOLCHAIN=local), npm install pinned npm11.12.1 and npm ci --ignore-scripts. No upstream source scripts, native compilation, build, test or model calls. Online public dependency downloads in ephemeral nonroot read-only containers; disconnect before export; private namespace/capdrop/no-newprivileges/no host mounts/socket/credentials.
outputPolicy: Regular download roots only. Refuse links/special entries rather than silently omit. Normalize tar UID/GID/mtime and executable permissions preserving file bytes. Exclude checkout node_modules, tooling installation trees, build outputs and caches, package-manager logs and Cargo global-cache metadata. No cache audit allTrue claims before independent audit. Archives remain scratch; git metadata/inventories/receipts only.
cacheState: draft-unqualified pending independent content audit and offline full-scope task requalification on common image
